title: DepRisk scan result (v1)
description: Output of 'deprisk scan --format json': the resolved dependency graph of every project found (NuGet or npm; one ecosystem per result). Deterministic: contains no timestamps and no machine-specific absolute paths.

assetsFile.description: Path of the file the graph was read from (NuGet project.assets.json, npm package-lock.json) relative to the scanned directory, with forward slashes.

projectFile.description: The project file relative to the scanned directory, forward slashes, when it can be determined: for NuGet (for example src/App/App.csproj) from the assets file's location, for npm the package.json next to the lock file if it exists; otherwise null.

name.description: NuGet: target framework (or, for assets file version 4, the target framework alias), optionally followed by '/' and a runtime identifier, for example 'net10.0' or 'net10.0/win-x64'. npm: always 'npm' (a lock file has one target).

isDirect.description: True if the project references this package itself (NuGet: a project reference; npm: the project or one of its workspace members asks for it and it is installed at the top level); false if it is only pulled in by other packages.

range.description: Version range the package declares for this dependency, in the ecosystem's notation (NuGet interval notation; npm node-semver range or specifier, as written).

requested.description: The constraint the project itself asked for, as written in the assets or lock file (for example '>= 1.2.0' for NuGet or '^4.17.0' for npm); null for transitive packages or when none was recorded.

path.description: Identifies the installed instance when the same package id can be installed several times in one project: for npm the key in the lock file's 'packages' map, for example 'node_modules/a/node_modules/b'. Null for NuGet.
